_doc: Media files shipped with LectureFlow (SPEC-v3 V4.3, V7). Every file under assets/ must be listed here: third-party media under "media" (path, title, creator, license, license_basis, at least one http(s) source, sha256 of the file; text files are hashed with CRLF normalised to LF), files written by the LectureFlow contributors under "own". Media licenses are judged against the general AGPL-3.0 table plus the media-only table in scripts/licaudit/policy.go (LicenseRef-Public-Domain). A missing source, license or basis, a hash mismatch or an unlisted file fails the audit.
